items.title: Windows 11 Notepad flaw let files execute silently via Markdown links
items.description: Microsoft has fixed a "remote code execution" vulnerability in Windows 11 Notepad that allowed attackers to execute local or remote programs by tricking users into clicking specially crafted Markdown links, without displaying any Windows security warnings. [...]

items.title: Microsoft Store Outlook add-in hijacked to steal 4,000 Microsoft accounts
items.description: The AgreeTo add-in for Outlook has been hijacked and turned into a phishing kit that stole more than 4,000 Microsoft account credentials. [...]
